 RTT  cwnd(MSS)  phase
   1          2  slow-start

  12         12  3 DUP-ACK -> ssthresh=12, cwnd=12 (fast recovery)

=== AIMD: additive increase, multiplicative decrease ===
  slow-start      : cwnd doubles every RTT (exponential)
  congestion-avoid: cwnd +1 MSS per RTT (linear)
  both losses     : ssthresh = cwnd/2
  difference      : timeout -> cwnd=1 (back to slow-start, HARSH)
                    3 dupACK -> cwnd=ssthresh (fast recovery, MILD)

=== why the difference? ===
  timeout  : no ACKs at all -> network may be badly congested -> retreat hard
  3 dupACK : ACKs still arrive -> path works, only one segment lost -> retreat gently

=== evolution ===
  Reno   : AIMD + fast recovery (classic)
  CUBIC  : cubic growth function, better on high-BDP links (Linux default)
  BBR    : measures bottleneck bandwidth + min RTT instead of treating loss as congestion

MSS_NAME = "MSS"

def simulate(loss_mode, initial_cwnd=1, initial_ssthresh=16, max_rounds=22):
    cwnd, ssthresh = float(initial_cwnd), float(initial_ssthresh)
    rows = []
    for rnd in range(1, max_rounds + 1):
        if cwnd < ssthresh:
            phase = "slow-start"
            cwnd = cwnd * 2
        else:
            phase = "congestion-avoid"
            cwnd = cwnd + 1
        rows.append((rnd, cwnd, phase))
        if cwnd >= 24:
            if loss_mode == "timeout":
                ssthresh = max(cwnd / 2, 2)
                cwnd = 1
                rows.append((rnd, cwnd, f"TIMEOUT -> ssthresh={ssthresh:g}, cwnd=1 (slow-start)"))
            else:
                ssthresh = max(cwnd / 2, 2)
                cwnd = ssthresh
                rows.append((rnd, cwnd, f"3 DUP-ACK -> ssthresh={ssthresh:g}, cwnd={ssthresh:g} (fast recovery)"))
            break
    return rows

for mode in ("timeout", "3dupack"):
    label = "TIMEOUT" if mode == "timeout" else "THREE DUPLICATE ACKs"
    print(f"=== Reno congestion control, loss by {label} ===")
    print(f"{'RTT':>4} {'cwnd(MSS)':>10}  phase")
    for rnd, cwnd, phase in simulate(mode):
        print(f"{rnd:>4} {cwnd:>10.0f}  {phase}")
    print()
